name: Sacrificial Boon
additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that consumes 10 Knowledge on use, not 5, to grant the user a random buff within a set pool. This has a 5 second cooldown, potentially allowing you to stack the buffs. Potential buffs are: 20% damage buff, hyperarmor for 10 seconds, instantly heal 50 health, stomach and thirst restoration, or a speed boost for 10 seconds. Executing a player with the Ritual Sacrifice awards 50 Knowledge.
desc: Sacrifice 5 knowledge to activate Blessing, giving you a random blessing from Navae.
